scope: deliberate training-case overfit test of causal message-conditioned receiver learning
principles: repeat the only screened pair whose left and right worlds both lie in the primary receiver band
include both latent worlds in every update so the receiver cannot infer the correct target from pair identity or its private observation
the critical receiver observations and legal actions are identical across worlds; only the teammate message identifies the active target
retain one exact matched decoy for every critical world so generic tactical gains remain distinguishable from message-conditioned behavior
train only receiver ACT spans because sender target-fact emission is saturated on this training slice
retain two remaining turns to keep verified terminal reward dense without adding action, capture, or message shaping

stages.name: pair7_two_world_communication_overfit
stages.purpose: test whether terminal-return RL can make blue-1 choose between two otherwise indistinguishable targets using blue-2's broadcast

primary_success_measure: critical generated-minus-dropped receiver target-action and terminal-return lift on the fixed development pulse
checkpoint_selection: development-only comparison after update 60; intermediate pulses diagnose trajectory only
frozen_policy: the existing rl_v4 selection and frozen OOD tiers remain byte-identical and unopened during this learnability run
limitation: a positive result establishes learnability on one repeated sender-receiver pair, not generalization or emergent swarm intelligence
